sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星辰之外是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最棒的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢用一个平底锅就能做好的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，陪伴您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为 nytimes.com 加上 subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: We start with the deadly aftermath of Hurricane Helene.
sentences.zh: 我们从飓风“海伦”带来的致命余波开始说起。

sentences.en: The storm carved the path of destruction through Florida, the Carolinas, Georgia, and Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴在佛罗里达州、卡罗来纳州、佐治亚州和田纳西州划出了一条破坏轨迹。

sentences.en: Over the past few days, Hurricane Helene left a trail of devastation across 600 miles.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几天里，飓风“海伦”在长达600英里的范围内留下了满目疮痍的痕迹。

sentences.en: You know, when Helene hit, it really didn't matter if your home was up on pilings or stilts because those homes are gone.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，“海伦”袭来时，你的房子是建在木桩上还是高脚柱上其实根本没有区别，因为那些房子都已经消失了。

sentences.en: Killing more than 100 people, driving thousands from their homes, and leaving millions without power.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴夺去了100多人的生命，迫使数万人背井离乡，并导致数百万人断电。

sentences.en: There's just no prepping for this kind of storm.
sentences.zh: 根本没有什么方法能为这种风暴做好准备。

sentences.en: There's no amount of sandbags that could have been put out.
sentences.zh: 准备再多的沙袋也无济于事。

sentences.en: But by far, the worst damage occurred where it was least expected, far inland in the mountains of western North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 但迄今为止，最严重的破坏发生在最意想不到的地方——远在北卡罗来纳州西部内陆的山区。

sentences.en: It's just a horrible situation and a horrible storm that took a lot from a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个可怕的局面，一场可怕的风暴，从许多人那里夺走了许多东西。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues, meteorologist Judson Jones and national reporter Nicholas Bogle Burroughs, on the storm and its toll.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事、气象学家朱德森·琼斯和国家新闻记者尼古拉斯·博格尔·伯勒斯将为我们讲述这场风暴及其造成的伤亡。
zh_words: 尼古拉斯·博格尔·伯勒斯

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月1日，星期二。

sentences.en: Dad, I wanted to start by asking you your overall reaction to what this hurricane has done.
sentences.zh: 爸爸，我想先问问你对这场飓风造成的破坏有什么总体看法。

sentences.en: You know, I expected it to be a major hurricane in the Gulf of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我原本预计它在墨西哥湾会是一场大型飓风。

sentences.en: Like, the models were apparent.
sentences.zh: 就像那些预测模型显示的那样。

sentences.en: It made landfall right where we expected it to make landfall.
sentences.zh: 它正如我们预期那样登陆了。

sentences.en: What wasn't apparent days ahead of time was the amount of rainfall that was going to fall in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 几天前无法预测的是北卡罗来纳州将要降下的降雨量。

sentences.en: I think the devastation in North Carolina is how this storm is going to be remembered.
sentences.zh: 我认为北卡罗来纳州的满目疮痍将成为人们对这场风暴的记忆。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about how Hurricane Helene gets to North Carolina and becomes so catastrophic there over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来聊聊飓风“海伦”是如何到达北卡罗来纳州并在周末在那里变得如此灾难性的。

sentences.en: I mean, last week, we were already monitoring Helene.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，上周我们已经在监测“海伦”了。

sentences.en: Full crew here.
sentences.zh: 全员都在这里。

sentences.en: We're taking off today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天出发。

sentences.en: I actually went up with a Hurricane Hunter aircraft and we flew into the storm of Helene with a group of scientists trying to locate the center of the storm.
sentences.zh: 我实际上是乘坐飓风猎人飞机出发的，我们和一群科学家一起飞进“海伦”风暴中，试图定位风暴的中心。

sentences.en: I think it might be to our north.
sentences.zh: 我想它可能在我们的北边。

sentences.en: We might have to see the AA.
sentences.zh: 我们可能得去看看那个AA区。

sentences.en: Wait, just you went up into Hurricane Helene yourself in a plane?
sentences.zh: 等等，你是说你亲自坐飞机飞进了飓风“海伦”里？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was with the Hurricane Hunters with the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.
sentences.zh: 对，我当时和美国国家海洋和大气管理局的飓风猎人在一起。

sentences.en: They fly into the heart of the storm to try to get a grasp of how strong the storm is.
sentences.zh: 他们飞入风暴核心，试图摸清风暴的强度。

sentences.en: They went on their mission Tuesday afternoon and I went with them.
sentences.zh: 他们星期二下午执行任务时，我和他们一起去了。

sentences.en: And for eight hours in the Caribbean Sea, we flew what's called a butterfly pattern in and out of the center of the storm.
sentences.zh: 在加勒比海上空的八个小时里，我们飞了一条所谓的蝴蝶航线，不断飞进飞出风暴中心。

sentences.en: We were dropping devices into the center of the storm to try to figure out just how strong it was.
sentences.zh: 我们把设备投放到风暴中心，试图弄清楚它到底有多强。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: When you're riding in one of these planes, you're all of a sudden dropping like a thousand feet, you know, in a second.
sentences.zh: 当你坐在其中一架飞机上时，你会突然在几秒钟内下坠大约一千英尺。

sentences.en: And then climbing back up and you're making bank turns.
sentences.zh: 然后又爬升回去，还要做急转弯。

sentences.en: They do give you sick bags and I will say I use mine.
sentences.zh: 他们确实会给你晕机袋，我得说我用上了我的。

sentences.en: You threw up during this fight.
sentences.zh: 你在这次飞行中吐了。

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对的。

sentences.en: Like it was, think of the worst turbulence you've ever experienced on a plane and then maybe magnify it a little bit.
sentences.zh: 就像是——想想你在飞机上经历过的最严重的颠簸，然后把它再稍微放大一点。

sentences.en: But, you know, the most important thing with that flight is as it was late afternoon, you could see the ocean up ahead of the storm and you could already see the whitecaps.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，那次飞行中最重要的是，当接近傍晚时，你可以看到风暴前方的大洋，而且你已经能看到白头浪了。

sentences.en: Can you just explain that, what that means to you to see those whirling whitecaps?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下吗，看到这些翻滚的白头浪对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: You're used to seeing whitecaps at the beach coming ashore and that has to do with the land interaction, right?
sentences.zh: 你习惯在海滩上看到拍岸的白头浪，那与陆地互动有关，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But you're out in the ocean, it's because of the wind.
sentences.zh: 但你身处大洋中，这是因为风。

sentences.en: And the wind was becoming so strong that you were starting to see these whitecaps out over the Caribbean Sea.
sentences.zh: 风变得如此强劲，以至于你在加勒比海上空开始看到这些白头浪。

sentences.en: It was this indication amongst the people on this plane that this was likely going to be an intense storm just based off of the appearance of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 机上的人们由此迹象判断，仅凭海洋的外观，这很可能会是一场强烈的风暴。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, it became a hurricane.
sentences.zh: 周三，它变成了一场飓风。

sentences.en: And then what we saw on Thursday was then it got over these really warm ocean waters of the Gulf of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在周四看到它掠过了墨西哥湾温暖的海水。

sentences.en: When it got over the absurdly warm ocean temperatures, kind of near bathtub-like temperatures,
sentences.zh: 当它掠过异常温暖的海水、温度几乎像浴缸里的水一样时，

sentences.en: this storm was able to fuel itself and get the energy it needed to rapidly intensify.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴得以自我补充能量，获得了迅速增强所需的能量。

sentences.en: And the Gulf of Mexico has never been warmer than it was as the storm came across it.
sentences.zh: 而且墨西哥湾从未像风暴穿过它时那样温暖。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as you've told us many times, if water is the fuel for a hurricane, warm water is like the supercharged premium jet fuel of fuel for a hurricane.
sentences.zh: 正如你多次告诉我们的那样，如果水是飓风的燃料，那么温暖的水就像是飓风的高效增压优质喷气燃料。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's how a storm jumps from a Category 1 to a Category 4 hurricane within 16 hours.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是为什么一场风暴能在16小时内从1级飓风跃升为4级飓风。

sentences.en: Which this one did.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴就是这样。

sentences.en: Which this one did.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴确实做到了。

sentences.en: And it was moving so fast, it didn't really have a chance to ever weaken.
sentences.zh: 而且它移动得如此之快，以至于它根本没有机会减弱。

sentences.en: So I landed in Perry, Florida, where it made landfall.
sentences.zh: 所以我降落在了它登陆的佛罗里达州佩里。

sentences.en: And as it came ashore, we experienced gusts of 99 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 当它上岸时，我们经历了每小时99英里的阵风。

sentences.en: The winds were so fierce, they were almost breaking a giant metal pole from a sign.
sentences.zh: 风是如此猛烈，几乎把一个广告牌的巨型金属杆都吹断了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And in what light was left, you could see the rain almost dancing like ballerinas moving through the sky.
sentences.zh: 在仅存的光线中，你可以看到雨在空中几乎像芭蕾舞演员一样翩翩起舞。

sentences.en: You could see these individual swirls moving across the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到这些独立的漩涡在停车场上移动。

sentences.en: But what kind of spared Perry, where I was as these winds were coming ashore, was the fact that the eye was so large.
sentences.zh: 但当这些风登陆时，我所在的佩里之所以能幸免于难，是因为它的风眼非常大。

sentences.en: So we were in the most intense winds that northeast part of the eye wall for only 20 to 30 minutes.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只在风眼墙东北部最强烈的风中待了20到30分钟。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden it went calm.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，风平浪静了。

sentences.en: And you could hear crickets and frogs.
sentences.zh: 你能听到蟋蟀和青蛙的叫声。

sentences.en: It just got still.
sentences.zh: 周围一下子变得静止了。

sentences.en: And it just got quiet.
sentences.zh: 一下子变得安静了。

sentences.en: And how long did that last until the backside of the eye came?
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了多久，直到风眼后半部分到来？

sentences.en: I mean, we were in the eye.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们当时在风眼里面。

sentences.en: It's hard to judge the time.
sentences.zh: 时间很难估算。

sentences.en: But it felt like 20 to 40 minutes.
sentences.zh: 但感觉像是20到40分钟。

sentences.en: But it almost felt longer in the eye than it did in the strongest winds.
sentences.zh: 在风眼里的感觉甚至比在最强风力中的时间还要长。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That tells you just how big this was.
sentences.zh: 这说明了这个风眼有多大。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it was a ginormous eye.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个庞大无比的风眼。

sentences.en: But the reason this eye was so large was because the storm was so large.
sentences.zh: 但这个风眼之所以这么大，是因为这场风暴本身就非常巨大。

sentences.en: The storm was being compared to the size of Katrina.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴的规模被拿来与“卡特里娜”飓风相提并论。

sentences.en: It took up the whole entire eastern Gulf of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 它占据了整个墨西哥湾东部。

sentences.en: The other issue was it wasn't just Florida.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是，受影响的不仅仅是佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: It was stretching into South Carolina and North Carolina as it was making landfall.
sentences.zh: 当它登陆时，其影响范围一直延伸到南卡罗来纳州和北卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: And then it moved so swiftly, it was already in Atlanta by Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 而且它移动得如此迅猛，以至于到周五早上就已经到达了亚特兰大。

sentences.en: But I followed the storm back towards Atlanta to my neighborhood that was also flooded that morning.
sentences.zh: 但我跟着风暴返回亚特兰大，回到了那天早上同样被淹的我的社区。

sentences.en: So you would have understood that this was merely a foretaste of what was to come in places like North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 所以你会明白，这仅仅是北卡罗来纳州等地即将发生的事情的预兆。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, North Carolina was already struggling.
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道的，北卡罗来纳州当时就已经在苦苦挣扎了。

sentences.en: And that's because of what's called a predecessor rainfall event.
sentences.zh: 这是因为所谓的倒前降水事件。

sentences.en: Can you explain that?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下吗？

sentences.en: It's just a fancy word for saying rain that is correlated with the storm happening before the storm gets there.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个花哨的词，用来指在风暴到达之前，与风暴相关的降雨。

sentences.en: What happens is there's another weather pattern that was happening across the central U.S.
sentences.zh: 发生这种情况是因为美国中部正在发生另一个天气系统。

sentences.en: That weather pattern connected with the hurricane was allowed to funnel warm, tropical, moist air from the Caribbean Sea all the way up into the mountains of the Appalachians.
sentences.zh: 该天气系统与飓风相连，使得加勒比海温暖、热带、潮湿的空气得以被漏斗般汇聚并一路输送到阿巴拉契亚山脉的山区。

sentences.en: And that moisture, when it hits the mountains, it's just as forced to rise and then fall back down as rain.
sentences.zh: 当这些湿气撞击山脉时，它们被迫上升，然后作为雨水落回地面。

sentences.en: The highest rainfall total from Wednesday to Saturday was 30 inches.
sentences.zh: 从周三到周六，最高的降雨总量达到了30英寸。

sentences.en: 30 inches falling on a mountain creates a calamity.
sentences.zh: 30英寸的雨水倾泻在山区，造成了一场灾难。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Two and a half feet of rain doesn't get absorbed into the system.
sentences.zh: 两点五英尺的雨水无法被水系吸收。

sentences.en: No, especially when it's been persistent.
sentences.zh: 是的，特别是当降雨持续不断的时候。

sentences.en: But Helene brought so much rain to the mountains in a place that just can't take that much rain.
sentences.zh: 但“海伦”给山区带来了如此多的雨水，而这个地方根本承受不了那么多的雨。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The other issue is one of the strongest wind gusts was actually in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是，其中一阵最强的阵风实际上就发生在山区。

sentences.en: And so you have the wet soil and then you have these strong winds and the trees come down.
sentences.zh: 所以你既有湿漉漉的土壤，又有这些强风，然后树木就被吹倒了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: This also sounds like a recipe for a mudslide.
sentences.zh: 这听起来也是泥石流的温床。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And so the Weather Prediction Center put out a high risk.
sentences.zh: 因此，气象预测中心发布了高级别风险警报。

sentences.en: It's the highest level you could put out for flooding.
sentences.zh: 这是你能为洪水发布的最高级别警报。

sentences.en: But how do you prepare?
sentences.zh: 但是你该如何准备呢？

sentences.en: It's one of those you can know all of this.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种你可能对所有这些都了然于胸的情况。

sentences.en: You know, we've seen it again and again for flooding.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们一次又一次地看到过洪水。

sentences.en: You don't really know until you see the river rising.
sentences.zh: 直到你看到河水上涨，你才真正有实感。

sentences.en: And that's what the real struggle is.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正的难点所在。

sentences.en: It's hard for people to visualize something that's normally calm and tranquil to be a raging river.
sentences.zh: 人们很难把平时平静祥和的河流想象成汹涌的洪流。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 真的很感激。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: After the break, what Hurricane Helene did to North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 广告之后，我们将带来飓风“海伦”对北卡罗来纳州造成的破坏。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的人那样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 加上 games 开始玩游戏吧。

sentences.en: By Saturday morning, a fuller picture emerged of just how much Hurricane Helene had devastated North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 到周六早上，一副更完整的画面呈现出来，显示了飓风“海伦”对北卡罗来纳州造成了多么毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: We have biblical devastation through the county.
sentences.zh: 我们整个县都遭到了堪称圣经记载般的毁灭性打击。

sentences.en: We've had biblical flooding here, and it has been extremely significant.
sentences.zh: 我们这里发生了堪称圣经记载般的洪水，情况极其严重。

sentences.en: Across the state's western edge, rising waters washed out roads, capsized buildings, and left thousands of residents without water, electricity, or a cell signal to call for help.
sentences.zh: 在该州西部的边缘，不断上涨的水位冲毁了房屋道路，掀翻了建筑物，并导致数千名居民没有水、没有电，也没有手机信号来呼叫救援。

sentences.en: Guys, just to give you an understanding of the devastation we're dealing with here, Chimney Rock's gone, Flowering Bridge is gone, and the fucking road's gone.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，为了让你们了解我们正在应对的满目疮痍，奇姆尼罗克没了，开花桥没了，他妈的道路也没了。

sentences.en: And so, I don't know what they're going to do to get us out of here, but we have to figure it out.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道他们会采取什么措施把我们弄出去，但我们必须想出办法。

sentences.en: Because this shit's crazy.
sentences.zh: 因为这破事太疯狂了。

sentences.en: The water also swallowed large parts of the town of Swannanoa, leaving only the rooftops of buildings peeking out.
sentences.zh: 洪水还吞没了斯旺纳诺亚镇的大片区域，只剩下建筑物的屋顶露在水面上。

sentences.en: With no way in or out, rescue workers resorted to flying in helicopters and dropping bags of food on top of a church and a Harley-Davidson shop.
sentences.zh: 由于无路可进也无路可出，救援人员只得用直升机飞入，在教堂和哈雷戴维森商店的顶部空投食物包。

sentences.en: When the rain was finally over, the Swannanoa River, which spans all 22 miles of Buncombe County, had broken every modern record for flooding.
sentences.zh: 当降雨终于停止时，横跨班孔姆县全部22英里长的斯旺纳诺亚河已经打破了所有的现代洪水记录。

sentences.en: It rose 19 feet in just 20 hours, peaking at more than 26 feet and submerging the city of Asheville.
sentences.zh: 它在短短20小时内上涨了19英尺，峰值超过26英尺，将阿什维尔市淹没。

sentences.en: A new drone video shows just how bad the situation is in Asheville.
sentences.zh: 一则新的无人机视频显示了阿什维尔目前的情况有多糟糕。

sentences.en: The city's now isolated after roads leading there flooded and cell towers were knocked down.
sentences.zh: 在通往该市的道路被淹且手机信号塔被毁后，这座城市现在已经与外界隔绝了。

sentences.en: I want to pan over, if we can, to just see some of these limbs as well.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我想把镜头平移过去，看一看其中一些树枝。

sentences.en: Oh, wow, look at that.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇，你看那个。

sentences.en: That is a dumpster that is just being carried by the water.
sentences.zh: 那是一个正被洪水冲走的垃圾箱。

sentences.en: So powerful, powerful water there.
sentences.zh: 水流太猛烈、太湍急了。

sentences.en: A video showed neighbors, stunned, as a perfectly intact beige house just floated by,
sentences.zh: 一段视频显示，邻居们惊恐地看着一栋完好无损的米色房屋漂了过来，

sentences.en: crashed into a tree, collapsed in on itself, and then disappeared under the water.
sentences.zh: 撞上一棵树，随后坍塌并消失在水面下。

sentences.en: By the end of the weekend, local online message boards lit up with frantic posts from people looking for their neighbors and their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 到周末结束时，当地的在线留言板上充满了焦急的帖子，人们都在寻找邻居和亲人。

sentences.en: One of them read,
sentences.zh: 其中一条写道：

sentences.en: Has anyone heard of or seen if the Lafer family is okay?
sentences.zh: 有人听说或看到拉弗一家是否平安吗？

sentences.en: Robin Lafer, her two sons, Jared and Brandon, I'm worried.
sentences.zh: 罗宾·拉弗和她的两个儿子贾里德和布兰登，我很担心。

sentences.en: And then there's a post from a woman who says she's looking for her mother and her stepfather, who live along one of the flooded rivers in the North Carolina mountains.
sentences.zh: 还有一条帖子来自一位女士，她说自己在寻找住在北卡罗来纳州山区被淹河流之一沿岸的母亲和继父。

sentences.en: She concludes by saying,
sentences.zh: 她在结尾写道：

sentences.en: I'm absolutely worried, out of my mind.
sentences.zh: 我真的很担心，整个人都要崩溃了。

sentences.en: As of Monday night, according to local officials, more than 500 people are still missing in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 据当地官员称，截至周一晚上，北卡罗来纳州仍有500多人失踪。

sentences.en: My colleague, national correspondent Nicholas Bogle Burroughs, ended up reconstructing the story of what happened to one of those missing people.
sentences.zh: 我的同事、国家特约记者尼古拉斯·博格·伯勒斯最终重构了其中一名失踪人员的遭遇。

sentences.en: Nick, tell us about how you ended up in this town and how you discovered the story of what happened to this man.
sentences.zh: 尼克，给我们讲讲你是怎么来到这个镇上的，以及你是如何发现这个男人的故事的。

sentences.en: So we had been reporting on the devastating effects that the hurricane had on Asheville.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在报道飓风对阿什维尔造成的毁灭性影响。

sentences.en: And what we kept hearing from people and families is that there were so many people in more isolated towns as well
sentences.zh: 我们从人们和家属那里不断听到的是，还有许多人身处更加偏远的城镇，

sentences.en: that were completely off the grid, that could not reach the outside world, in some cases couldn't even get outside of where they were.
sentences.zh: 他们完全与世隔绝，无法与外界取得联系，有时甚至无法离开他们所在的地方。

sentences.en: And we started hearing about Marshall.
sentences.zh: 我们开始听到关于马歇尔的消息。

sentences.en: It's a very small, beautiful town of about 800 along a big river, the French Broad River.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常小而美丽的小镇，紧邻一条大河——法国布罗德河，人口约有800人。

sentences.en: We knew that it had been hit very hard by floodwaters, and so we weren't sure how close we would be able to get.
sentences.zh: 我们知道它被洪水严重袭击过，所以我们不确定自己能接近到什么程度。

sentences.en: But a photographer and I decided to drive over there and talk to people about what their last few days had been like.
sentences.zh: 但一位摄影师和我决定开车过去，向人们了解他们过去几天的经历。

sentences.en: And I met with a husband and wife and their son who were pulling all of their belongings from a house in trash bags along this railroad.
sentences.zh: 我遇到了一对夫妻和他们的儿子，他们正沿着这条铁路线，用垃圾袋把所有的物品从一栋房子里搬出来。

sentences.en: And one of the first things that they mentioned was this harrowing story down the street about a 75-year-old man who had clung to a tree for life as the floodwaters came in.
sentences.zh: 他们提到的一件头等大事，就是街头发生的一起惊心动魄的故事：随着洪水涌入，一名75岁的老人紧紧抱住一棵树求生。

sentences.en: So the photographer and I decided to walk down the railroad towards that house and try to figure out what had happened.
sentences.zh: 于是摄影师和我决定沿着铁路线走向那栋房子，试着弄清楚发生了什么。

sentences.en: You know, it's a dead-end road, so everybody knows everybody.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是一条死胡同，所以每个人都认识彼此。

sentences.en: Some neighbors pointed out where he lived down on Rollins Road, and we turned down this little driveway and see essentially the ruins of his home.
sentences.zh: 一些邻居指出了他住在罗林斯路的房子，我们拐进这条小车道，基本上看到了他家的废墟。

sentences.en: You can see part of the debris, debris right there.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到部分残骸，就在那里的残骸。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And those trees.
sentences.zh: 还有那些树。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the people who live in that neighborhood tell us that the man who lived there was Bruce Tipton.
sentences.zh: 住在那个社区的人告诉我们，住在那里的这个人叫布鲁斯·蒂普顿。

sentences.en: No, he was always up and down the road in his little red pickup truck with his dog.
sentences.zh: 不，他总是开着他那辆带着狗的小红色皮卡车在路上来来往往。

sentences.en: Okay, yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的，是的。

sentences.en: You know, making sure everything was, you know, all right and everything.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，确保一切都，你知道的，都好好的之类的。

sentences.en: He just was a quiet country guy.
sentences.zh: 他只是个安静的乡村汉子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we start to learn about who he was and what happened on Friday night during this storm.
sentences.zh: 我们开始了解他是谁，以及周五晚上风暴期间发生了什么。

sentences.en: Essentially, Bruce Tipton had lived in this home for a long, long time, and he had decided to stay while other people were evacuating this area.
sentences.zh: 基本上，布鲁斯·蒂普顿在这个家里住了很长很长一段时间，当其他人都在撤离这个地区时，他决定留下来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I waved at him, he waved at me, and I said, you know, and then I can't sit there and do that.
sentences.zh: 我向他挥手，他向我挥手，我说，你知道的，然后我就没法坐在那里不管了。

sentences.en: One of the neighbors described feeling a little bit worried about him.
sentences.zh: 其中一位邻居描述说对他感到有点担心。

sentences.en: And then essentially what happened is that the water rose and rose.
sentences.zh: 基本上发生的事情是水位不断上涨。

sentences.en: The water from the river went down this road by his house, and it was essentially like his house was on its own island in this rushing river
sentences.zh: 河水顺着他家旁边的这条路涌下来，他的房子基本上就像是处在汹涌河水中的孤岛上，

sentences.en: that was more violent and higher than anyone remembers it ever being before.
sentences.zh: 这河水比任何人记忆中的都要湍急、水位都要高。

sentences.en: Bruce is standing in the doorway next to his porch, and his family, many of whom live in the area, are up on shore watching him just stand there as the water's rising.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯站在门廊旁的门口，他的家人（其中许多人住在附近）在岸上看着他站在那里，而水位正在上涨。

sentences.en: And they're, you know, all hoping that the water will stop rising and that he will be able to get out safely once it recedes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们都希望水位停止上涨，希望他能在水退后安全撤离。

sentences.en: Instead, what happened is that...
sentences.zh: 相反，发生的事情是……

sentences.en: The trailer broke.
sentences.zh: 拖车散架了。

sentences.en: It was kind of like exploded.
sentences.zh: 有点像爆炸了一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Like it was just a mobile home.
sentences.zh: 就像它只是一辆移动房屋一样。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, as he's standing in the doorway, his home just completely crumples.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，正当他站在门口时，他的家完全坍塌了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the river just broke it apart in pieces.
sentences.zh: 河水直接把它冲得粉碎。

sentences.en: I mean, you see it's just ripping it to shreds.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你看它简直被撕成了碎片。

sentences.en: Did you see...
sentences.zh: 你看到了……

sentences.en: The entire home was destroyed.
sentences.zh: 整栋房子都被毁了。

sentences.en: And it happened so quick.
sentences.zh: 而且发生得太快了。

sentences.en: One minute he's standing in the front door, and the next minute the trailer's gone.
sentences.zh: 前一分钟他还站在前门，后一分钟拖车就没了。

sentences.en: His dog, his German shepherd that everyone knew him by, ran out and was able to get to shore and was rescued.
sentences.zh: 他的狗，那只大家都认得他的德国牧羊犬，跑了出去，设法上了岸并获救了。

sentences.en: But they thought that Bruce was gone.
sentences.zh: 但他们以为布鲁斯已经不在了。

sentences.en: They thought that he had been swept down the river.
sentences.zh: 他们以为他被大水冲走了。

sentences.en: And then, amazingly...
sentences.zh: 然后，令人惊奇的是……

sentences.en: Somebody after a while said, he's hollering.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿有人说，他在大喊。

sentences.en: So we run up there and yelled across the river,
sentences.zh: 所以我们跑过去，朝着河对岸大喊，

sentences.en: Bruce!
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯！

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: 30 minutes later, an hour later, they hear him shout.
sentences.zh: 30分钟后，一小时后，他们听到他的喊声。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And it turns out that he had somehow been swept towards a tree, maybe 40 feet away, and was clinging to life behind this tree near his home.
sentences.zh: 原来他不知怎么被冲到了一棵树旁，大约40英尺远，紧紧抓着他家附近这棵树后面的求生生机。

sentences.en: It's so loud.
sentences.zh: 声音太大了。

sentences.en: All he could ever do was yell, help.
sentences.zh: 他能做的只有大喊，救命。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And he was in that tree...
sentences.zh: 他在那棵树上……

sentences.en: They just heard him shout, help, help, again and again.
sentences.zh: 他们只听到他一遍又一遍地喊着，救命，救命。

sentences.en: And once they heard that, they all started shouting back.
sentences.zh: 一旦听到这个，大家就开始齐声回应。

sentences.en: Me and at least five other men with loud voices, we were yelling,
sentences.zh: 我和至少另外五个大嗓门的男人，我们在大喊，

sentences.en: Bruce!
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯！

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We have your dog!
sentences.zh: 我们带着你的狗呢！

sentences.en: You know, to encourage him to hold on or do whatever.
sentences.zh: 你知道，为了鼓励他坚持下去或者做点什么。

sentences.en: And it was just the moSt...
sentences.zh: 这简直是……

sentences.en: I mean, they were trying to keep him talking.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们试图让他保持说话。

sentences.en: You know, they didn't know how injured he was or what condition he was in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们不知道他伤得有多重，也不知道他的状况如何。

sentences.en: They were trying to keep his spirits up as much as you can and give him hope that he would be rescued.
sentences.zh: 他们尽最大努力让他振作精神，给他获救的希望。

sentences.en: And that's essentially the communication that they had for the next six, seven hours.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是他们接下来六、七个小时的交流方式。

sentences.en: Wait, for six hours, this 75-year-old man is clinging to a tree in fast-moving water all around him?
sentences.zh: 等等，整整六个小时，这个75岁的老人周围都是急流，他却紧紧抓着一棵树？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And it's hard to overestimate how strong this river was moving.
sentences.zh: 很难高估这条河的水流有多猛烈。

sentences.en: It's a wide river.
sentences.zh: 这是一条宽阔的河。

sentences.en: It's rushing down.
sentences.zh: 水流奔腾而下。

sentences.en: And he's essentially in the river.
sentences.zh: 他基本上身处河中。

sentences.en: He's in this tree that is being hit by the water constantly.
sentences.zh: 他在这棵不断遭到水流冲击的树上。

sentences.en: And there's plywood and other debris that's flowing down.
sentences.zh: 还有合板和其他顺流而下的残骸。

sentences.en: And it was very, very dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这非常非常危险。

sentences.en: Nick, did any of these people attempt to wade out into the water and rescue Bruce?
sentences.zh: 尼克，这些人里有人试图蹚水去救布鲁斯吗？

sentences.en: Or was it just so evident that they themselves would be washed away if they did?
sentences.zh: 还是说很明显，如果他们这么做了，自己也会被冲走？

sentences.en: So they absolutely kicked into high gear.
sentences.zh: 所以他们确实全力以赴了。

sentences.en: One person said there might have been 25 or 30 people there and they're all trying to figure out what they can do to help him.
sentences.zh: 有人说当时可能有25或30人在那里，他们都在想能做些什么来帮他。

sentences.en: And one man is tying a...
sentences.zh: 有一个人正在把一个……

sentences.en: Sorry, it's raining here.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，这里在下雨。

sentences.en: One man is tying a cable around his waist and looking out to see if he thinks he could go out there.
sentences.zh: 一个人正把一根缆绳绑在腰上，向外张望，看他觉得自己能不能出去。

sentences.en: And he started to take his shirt off and he said, just get a rope on me.
sentences.zh: 他开始脱掉衬衫说，给我绑上一根绳子。

sentences.en: I'm going out there.
sentences.zh: 我要去那儿。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I told him,
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，

sentences.en: Jay, I said,
sentences.zh: 杰伊，我说，

sentences.en: please don't do that.
sentences.zh: 请不要那样做。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You'll drown.
sentences.zh: 你会淹死的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He has kids and...
sentences.zh: 他有孩子，而且……

sentences.en: You know, but it was his uncle, so...
sentences.zh: 你知道的，但那是他的叔叔，所以……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They basically realized that this was no match for them and anyone who went into the water was sure to just be swept away before having a chance to get to Bruce.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上意识到他们根本无能为力，任何下水的人在有机会接近布鲁斯之前肯定都会被冲走。

sentences.en: So they called for help.
sentences.zh: 所以他们呼叫了救援。

sentences.en: They called the fire department.
sentences.zh: 他们打了消防局的电话。

sentences.en: There is one river rescue team in the entire county and it's all volunteers.
sentences.zh: 整个县只有一支河流救援队，而且全部是志愿者。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: They brought rafts and they carried rafts down the bank from this road up here and they went and put rafts in the water.
sentences.zh: 他们带来了救生筏，从上面这条路的河岸把救生筏扛下来，然后把救生筏放进水里。

sentences.en: They took a look at the situation and said that there was no way that they could go in safely.
sentences.zh: 他们查看了情况，并表示他们绝对不可能安全下水。

sentences.en: They didn't have a motor for their boat.
sentences.zh: 他们的船没有发动机。

sentences.en: It was too dark.
sentences.zh: 天太黑了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And when they told me they wouldn't put boats in the water, I lost it.
sentences.zh: 当他们告诉我他们不会把船放进水里时，我崩溃了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I flipped.
sentences.zh: 我发飙了。

sentences.en: Like, why did you bring them and race the resources and all that if you had no intentions of putting them in the water?
sentences.zh: 就像，既然你们根本没打算把船放进水里，为什么要把它们带来、浪费资源和这一切呢？

sentences.en: Jesus.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That really angered the family but the chief of that rescue team has told me today that it was just impossible that he felt like if they went in that water they might lose
sentences.zh: 这确实激怒了家属，但该救援队队长今天告诉我，这根本不可能，他觉得如果他们下水，可能会失去

sentences.en: basically the county's entire rescue team.
sentences.zh: 基本上全县所有的救援力量。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: As they're trying to handle other operations.
sentences.zh: 当时他们正试图处理其他救援行动。

sentences.en: So what ends up happening to Bruce?
sentences.zh: 那么布鲁斯最终怎么了？

sentences.en: One of Bruce's nieces who was there,
sentences.zh: 当时在场的布鲁斯的一个侄女，

sentences.en: Annie Meadows,
sentences.zh: 安妮·米多斯，

sentences.en: described what happened next.
sentences.zh: 描述了接下来发生的事情。

sentences.en: And he come out of the tree at 10.51 Friday night and he just kind of went limp and he just fell over and his head went first in the water.
sentences.zh: 他在周五晚上10点51分从树上脱手，他只是有点浑身发软，然后倒了下去，头部先落入水中。

sentences.en: And they still haven't found him.
sentences.zh: 他们到现在还没找到他。

sentences.en: She says that she saw his body be swept away downriver towards the town.
sentences.zh: 她说她看到他的尸体顺流而下，朝着镇子的方向被冲走了。

sentences.en: Um, yeah, I'd...
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，我……

sentences.en: I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 我非常难过。

sentences.en: Just knowing that you couldn't get to something, even if it wasn't him.
sentences.zh: 只要一想到你无法接近某个东西，即使那不是他。

sentences.en: And you're sitting there and you're hearing somebody hollering for help and nobody's offering to do anything.
sentences.zh: 而你坐在那里，听到有人在大声呼救，却没有人主动去做任何事。

sentences.en: Like, I don't see leaving somebody to die whether it's my family or I just don't see that.
sentences.zh: 就像，我无法接受留着某人去死，不管是我的家人还是谁，我就是无法接受。

sentences.en: Like, my old man was the first one in the water.
sentences.zh: 就像，我老爸是第一个下水的人。

sentences.en: And part of what's so difficult, I mean, there's so many things that are devastating about this, but they don't even know was he injured and did he pass away and then fall
sentences.zh: 最难的部分之一，我的意思是，这件事有太多令人痛心的地方，但他们甚至不知道他是受伤了、去世了然后掉下去的，

sentences.en: or did he just run out of energy and couldn't hang on anymore?
sentences.zh: 还是说他只是耗尽了体力，再也抓不住了？

sentences.en: They're left with so many questions.
sentences.zh: 他们留下了无数的疑问。

sentences.en: And among them is the fact that his body has still not been recovered.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是他的遗体至今仍未找到。

sentences.en: They don't know where it is, where it could be.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道遗体在哪里，可能在哪里。

sentences.en: Bruce's sister asked her niece to check through the rubble near his home just in case his body was there, which she described as incredibly traumatic to do.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯的姐姐让侄女去他家附近的废墟中寻找，以防他的遗体在那里，她形容这个过程极其痛苦。

sentences.en: But she knew he wasn't there because she saw him be swept down the river.
sentences.zh: 但她知道他不在那里，因为她亲眼看到他被冲进河里。

sentences.en: Do they have any hope that he's still alive?
sentences.zh: 他们对他还活着还抱有任何希望吗？

sentences.en: The relatives and neighbors that I talk to do not.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的亲属和邻居都没有这种希望。

sentences.en: They are sure of what they saw with their own eyes and how strong this river was that if he was swept into it, that there's really no chance.
sentences.zh: 他们坚信自己亲眼所见以及这条河是多么湍急，如果他被卷入其中，确实毫无生还可能。

sentences.en: I wonder if you're hearing other stories like this one in Marshall or really any of these towns that were so devastated by this hurricane.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你在马歇尔或受这场飓风重创的其他任何城镇中，是否也听到了类似的故事？

sentences.en: Are people angry?
sentences.zh: 人们在愤怒吗？

sentences.en: Are they in mourning?
sentences.zh: 他们在哀悼吗？

sentences.en: How would you describe what people are feeling there right now?
sentences.zh: 你会如何形容那里的人们此刻的感受？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I mean, there are so many stories of loved ones missing in eastern Tennessee, western North Carolina, across the states.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在田纳西州东部、北卡罗来纳州西部以及整个州，有太多关于亲人失踪的故事。

sentences.en: And then there is also just the destruction of places that mean so much to people as well.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，还有那些对人们意义重大的地方遭到了彻底摧毁。

sentences.en: People have no idea what the rebuild is going to look like, if it's going to happen, what's going to come of this.
sentences.zh: 人们根本不知道重建会是什么样子，是否会发生，这一切最终会走向何方。

sentences.en: They are trying to process losing a family member and also not even knowing if the town that they grew up in or have known their whole lives is going to be a town again
sentences.zh: 他们正努力承受失去亲人之痛，甚至不知道自己长大的或一辈子生活的城镇是否还能再次成为一个小镇

sentences.en: or what that's going to look like.
sentences.zh: 或者那将会是什么样子。

sentences.en: There's just an incredible amount of grief throughout the entire region right now.
sentences.zh: 现在整个地区都弥漫着难以言喻的巨大悲痛。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I want to express condolences to all the families, to all the families whose loved ones have died or are missing.
sentences.zh: 我要向所有的家庭表达慰问，向所有亲人去世或失踪的家庭表达慰问。

sentences.en: On Monday,
sentences.zh: 周一，

sentences.en: President Biden addressed the devastation in North Carolina from the White House and put special emphasis on those who are still unaccounted for.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统在白宫发表讲话，谈到了北卡罗来纳州的满目疮痍，并特别强调了那些至今下落不明的人。

sentences.en: Matter of fact, it's almost equally as bad missing not knowing whether or not your brother, sister, husband, wife, son, daughter or a lot.
sentences.zh: 事实上，失踪甚至同样糟糕，因为你不知道你的兄弟、姐妹、丈夫、妻子、儿子、女儿还是其他人是否安全。

sentences.en: Biden said he had dispatched thousands of federal aid workers to the region, but he warned that rebuilding would be a long and expensive process.
sentences.zh: 拜登表示，他已向该地区派遣了数千名联邦援助人员，但他警告称，重建将是一个漫长而昂贵的过程。

sentences.en: The president is scheduled to travel to North Carolina and survey the damage for himself tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 总统计划于明天前往北卡罗来纳州并亲自视察灾情。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Tuesday morning,
sentences.zh: 周二上午，

sentences.en: Israel said that its troops had begun crossing into southern Lebanon a major escalation in its efforts to debilitate Hezbollah.
sentences.zh: 以色列表示，其军队已开始越境进入黎巴嫩南部，这是其削弱真主党行动中的一次重大升级。

sentences.en: Both Israel and the United States said that the invasion was a narrow operation consisting of small groups of Israeli commandos designed to remove
sentences.zh: 以色列和美国均表示，这次入侵是一次小规模行动，由小型以色列突击队组成，旨在清除

sentences.en: Hezbollah sites that have threatened
sentences.zh: 在过去一年中威胁到

sentences.en: Israel's northern border over the past year.
sentences.zh: 以色列北部边境的真主党据点。

sentences.en: But the plan could still evolve into a larger and more prolonged invasion.
sentences.zh: 但该计划仍有可能演变成更大规模、持续更久的入侵。

sentences.en: Israel has carried out several waves of attacks against Hezbollah over the past few weeks, including intense airstrikes that, according to local officials,
sentences.zh: 过去几周里，以色列对真主党发动了多波攻击，包括密集的空袭。据当地官员称，

sentences.en: have killed hundreds of people in Lebanon, including 95 people, on Monday alone.
sentences.zh: 这些空袭已导致黎巴嫩数百人丧生，仅周一一天就有95人遇难。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在家般温馨的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会喝到不省人事才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用上或在你喜欢收听播客的任何地方搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
